scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:fresh: npm run dev:stop && npm run dev
scripts.dev:local: npm run dev:stop && (docker start egas-mongo 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name egas-mongo -p 27017:27017 -v egas-mongo-data:/data/db mongo:7) && MONGO_URI=mongodb://localhost:27017/egas_clearance npm run dev
